recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed in FHIR core unless a future publication check finds generated Appointment pages diverging from the authoritative StructureDefinition source.
issue_request: FHIR-3349 was a Published/Persuasive correction for FHIR-core Appointment reporting that the Appointment documentation linked to http://hl7.org/fhir/vs/encounter-reason, which 404ed, while the value set identity should use the encounter-reason value set.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-3349. Jira comments from March 2015 say the issue was already fixed, and git history shows commit 3c8bef2fb3e86a56a8efb32857f71baebc766a76 later normalized the Appointment spreadsheet binding from http://hl7.org/fhir/vs/encounter-reason to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-reason as part of value set identifier cleanup. The current XML source now carries that canonical URL.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml is in current build scope. The encounter-reason ValueSet source itself declares http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-reason. No Confluence Jira references were found for FHIR-3349, and broader community searches did not reveal any conflicting later decision about this link.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Appointment.reason binding already points at http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-reason, matching the current ValueSet canonical URL and avoiding the broken /vs/ link reported by the issue.
